newsitem.title: USA: Unicom, Sonat form gas marketing venture.
newsitem.headline: Unicom, Sonat form gas marketing venture.

text.p: Unicom Energy Services and Sonat Marketing Co LP said Wednesday they formed a natural gas marketing joint venture company to be named Unicom Gas Services.
Unicom Energy Services is the unregulated energy marketing subsidiary of Unicom Corp. Sonat Marketing is the natural gas marketing subsidiary of Sonat Inc.
"This new entity will market retail natural gas and related services to commercial and industrial customers throughout the Midwest region," Unicom Chairman James O'Connor said in a statement.
He said the venture will add to Unicom's porfolio of energy products and services.

"Our strategic objective for energy marketing at Sonat has been to find premier partners to join us in serving the energy consumer," Sonat Inc Chairman Ronald Kuehn Jr said in a statement. "The combination of Unicom's knowledge of the commercial and industrial energy customer in the Midwest and Sonat's multi-regional natural gas expertise is an ideal example of that strategic objective."

Unicom is the parent of Commonwealth Edison Co, an electric utility; Unicom Resources Inc, which develops power projects and other business ventures, and Unicom Energy Services, an unregulated marketing organization that provides energy products and services to retail customers.
Sonat is an integrated oil and natural gas company.
